stories.title: Meta Settles Child Harm Case For Billions
stories.summary:
Meta has agreed to pay up to $17.1 billion to settle a landmark lawsuit brought by a bipartisan group of dozens of states. The suit alleged that Facebook and Instagram were designed in ways that exploited children and teens.

The proposed settlement requires Meta to make sweeping changes to its platforms, including time limits and nighttime access restrictions. Al Jazeera reports the figure as $16.68 billion, while Breitbart cites roughly $18 billion, reflecting minor discrepancies in how outlets framed the final amount.

stories.title: Bodies found on S Korean holiday island as missing persons scandal deepens
stories.summary:
Bodies of four missing people were found on Jeju Island, a popular holiday destination in South Korea. The discovery has intensified a national scandal over how missing persons cases are handled by police.

A police sergeant was arrested after accusations that he lied to victims' families and prematurely closed their cases. Authorities have not yet confirmed the cause of death or whether the deaths were connected to each other.

stories.title: ‘Rocky Horror’ Legend Tim Curry Dead At 80
stories.summary:
Tim Curry, the British actor best known for playing Dr. Frank-N-Furter in The Rocky Horror Picture Show, has died at age 80.

Curry passed away late Tuesday night at his Los Angeles home after suffering from several health issues over the past decade, including years of stroke recovery. Police arrived at the scene just before midnight and reported that foul play is not suspected.

His career spanned cult classics such as The Rocky Horror Picture Show, Home Alone 2, Clue, and a role as the evil clown in IT.

stories.title: Federal Judge Kills Texas Drag Show Ban, Saying It Would Even Land Dolly Parton in Jail
stories.summary:
A federal judge struck down a 2023 Texas law restricting drag shows, ruling that the statute violated the First Amendment's guarantee of free speech.

Judge David Hittner blocked state Attorney General Ken Paxton from enforcing Senate Bill 12, citing protections for expressive performance and free speech.

The court found the law's definitions so broad they could have criminalized performers as varied as the late Dolly Parton. This marks a second judicial strike-down of the Texas drag show ban.

stories.title: Instagram CEO denies company hid low use of teen safety feature in Meta trial
stories.summary:
Meta has agreed to major changes to Facebook and Instagram as it settles a US trial over teen addiction for up to $17 billion. The company will establish further protections for teens, including daily usage limits and blocks on nighttime use.

Instagram CEO Adam Mosseri testified in the blockbuster lawsuit brought by 29 US states, disputing allegations that his company hid negative information from the public. He told a California courtroom, “I am not trying to encourage my team to hide anything.”

The settlement ends a landmark lawsuit in which dozens of US states accused Meta of addicting and harming children with dangerous products.

stories.title: DepEd launches AI-powered platform for school disaster preparedness
stories.summary:
The Department of Education in the Philippines has launched an artificial intelligence-driven platform called LIGTAS+ to improve disaster preparedness across school communities. The system, formally known as Learning Institution Geohazard Tracking and Assessment for Safety, is designed to provide clearer and more actionable information to support schools nationwide.

The rollout aims to strengthen disaster resilience by using AI-powered features to track geohazards and assess risks in educational institutions. Officials stated that the platform will help schools respond more effectively to multi-hazard threats.

stories.summary:
The Department of Health has activated fast lanes for leptospirosis patients at 33 government hospitals across five Luzon regions.

The measure follows a surge in cases linked to widespread flooding from weeks-long monsoon rains. The express lanes are available in Metro Manila, Ilocos region, Cagayan Valley, Central Luzon, and the Cordillera Administrative Region.

stories.title: Meta settles for $18 billion in lawsuit brought by 29 states over social media harms to children
stories.summary:
Meta has agreed to pay $18 billion to settle a lawsuit brought by 29 states. The suit alleged that the company knowingly designed platforms such as Instagram and Facebook to addict children.

The states claimed Meta understood the potential harms its products could pose to young users. The settlement resolves claims related to social media effects on minors.

stories.title: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival – a game so grotesque it scares its own director
stories.summary:
Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival is a horror game developed under the direct oversight of author Clive Barker, who lends his name and creative input to the project. The title marks a revival of the cult franchise, aiming to bring its signature discomfort to new audiences through modern interactive design.

Actor Doug Bradley returns to voice Pinhead, reprising the role he originated in the original film series. His involvement anchors the game’s tone to the source material while updating it for contemporary players.

Director Emil Esov has described a physical reaction from Barker during development sessions, suggesting the project achieves an intensity that unsettles even its own overseer. Esov also noted discovering his own trypophobia while researching visual discomfort, which informed design choices around texture and imagery.

stories.title: London rollout of robotaxis delayed amid lack of guidance for firms to follow
stories.summary:
The rollout of robotaxis in London is unlikely to occur this year, according to The Guardian. Uber and Wayve had previously stated they would begin trips later this summer, but regulatory and technical hurdles have pushed back the schedule set by the UK government.

Firms face a lack of clear guidance for following regulations, which has contributed to the delay. The original timeline was ambitious, and current conditions make an in-year launch improbable.
